newsitem.title: UK: NWE straight-run fuel oil edges higher.
newsitem.headline: NWE straight-run fuel oil edges higher.

text.p: NWE straight-run fuel oil prices were firmer as a result of stronger crude futures although gains were minimal, traders said.
An ARA player was heard seeking prompt low sulphur straight-run fuel oil but none was seen available in the region before around August 10. Bids were heard at around $102/$103 fob NWE on a fob basis.
High sulphur straight-run was also available out of the Baltics, traders said, although no material was heard traded. -- London newsroom +44 171 542 8167
